BPT: Find EC, Class 10 board exam: in △ABC with DE ∥ BC, use the Basic Proportionality Theorem.

• DE ∥ BC, so by BPT: AD/DB = AE/EC
• 1.5/3 = 1/EC, and 1.5/3 = 1/2
• Cross multiply: EC = 2 × 1 = 2 cm
